description: This file contains unit tests for the MotionHandler class in an Android application, specifically testing motion activity and pedometer data handling with mocked data sources.

classes.name: MotionHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the MotionHandler's motion activity and pedometer handling functions.

classes.name: FakeMotionDataSource
classes.description: Mock data source implementing MotionDataSource interface for testing purposes, providing simulated motion activity and pedometer data and errors.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests that handling motion activity requires appropriate permission; expects a permission error if permission is not granted.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Tests that invalid JSON input results in an appropriate error response.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_returnsActivityPayload
methods.description: Tests that a valid motion activity returns the expected payload containing activity details.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer_mapsRangeUnsupportedError
methods.description: Tests handling of errors thrown by the pedometer, specifically when range is unsupported.
